_about: Frame-review checklist for scorecard v2. status: open | review (fixed in code, not yet seen in frames; still counts as open) | closed (seen fixed, evidence given). severity: high | medium | low. Seeded from the 2026-11-11 full-game review (D:/TAGFullGame).

checks.title: Get-offs from the wrong side's pool (C fires off with a DL clip, DL with an OL pass-set or a guard pull)
checks.evidence: p5: role_mismatch off_dl_clip 0, def_ol_clip 0 (get-off pools by job)

checks.title: Kick returner sprints in the crouched comeback-catch clip
checks.evidence: p5 c001 f120-138: comeback catch clip ends 0.5 s after the catch, then MM run (one-shot catch exit)

checks.title: No touchdown celebrations (183 clips loaded, none played)
checks.evidence: p5: 2 of 2 touchdowns celebrated (team celebration, telemetry clip:*Celeb*)

checks.title: Receivers sprint with an arm raised on run plays
checks.evidence: p7: role_mismatch armsup_on_run 0 (was 2914 frames in p5)

checks.title: At contact the rusher's torso passes into the blocker's shoulder
checks.evidence: line test 12 Nov (tag_linetest_047-071): hands to the chest plate, upper bodies clear (ResolveEngagedOverlap: chest 52 cm, helmet-to-chest 38 cm for any two standing men); the pancake finish (035) still overlaps as the end goes down: under int_pile_limbs

checks.title: No help-up, ball to the official or varied jog back after the whistle
checks.evidence: full-game review

checks.title: Jerseys and pants read as glossy plastic (no knit / twill)
checks.evidence: tag_lineup_face_focus / face_celebrate (12 Nov): matte jersey with an in-house mesh knit, twill pants; no licensed maps

checks.title: No front jersey numbers
checks.evidence: tag_lineup_celebrate_a (12 Nov): front numbers read at field distance (67, 58, 36) at 23 cm

checks.title: No helmet logos (fictional teams have no marks)
checks.evidence: tag_lineup_helmet_away / _home (12 Nov): team marks on both shell sides (Kings K on a disc, Twisters T on a shield), upright, team colours

checks.title: No shoulder/sleeve TV numbers
checks.evidence: close-ups

checks.title: Kicker wears #82
checks.evidence: p5 telemetry: kickers wear #6 / #10, punters #1 / #16 (K/P ranges 1-19, kick units start with the real K)

checks.title: Crowd near the sideline reads as low-detail cards in close shots
Chain-crew rods render as a slanted orange bar
checks.evidence: full-game review

checks.title: Officials' uniforms: no numbers, the referee's white cap
checks.evidence: full-game review

checks.title: Referee lines up 2-4 yd from the QB and ends up in the sack pile
checks.evidence: p10 telemetry (refw): the referee within 1 m of a player in 0.4% of live frames (28 of 7,000) from his station 12 yd deep, 5.5 yd wide; no longer in sack piles

checks.title: Officials walk through players
checks.evidence: p13 telemetry: no official closer than 42 cm to any player all game (bodies never overlap); within 1 m in 0.32% of frames, mostly the referee taking the ball (OfficialDodge + OfficialPushOut)

checks.title: One on-field official instead of a seven-man crew
checks.evidence: p7 c021 f80, c007 f205: striped crew on the field (wings on the sidelines, deep men downfield) besides the referee

checks.title: Arms pass through helmets and shoulders in piles
checks.evidence: c001 f215; line test 035: a pancake finish puts the falling end's chest inside the blocker's shoulder

checks.title: Deep passes thrown past the end line, men running into the stands
checks.evidence: p1 telemetry: ball max x 111.3 (was 188.4); SimTests 'passes stay on the field'

checks.title: Linemen block 65 yd downfield on a breakaway
checks.evidence: 200 headless games: deepest engaged OL block 16 yd (was 48); SimTests leash

checks.title: Backup QBs rotate in mid-drive
checks.evidence: 200 games: 7 changes, all injuries; SimTests 'starters stay in'

checks.title: Coverage too loose at 10-19 yd after the movement limits (separation 3.2-3.6 yd)
checks.evidence: SimCalibrate 200 games

checks.title: CPU games stall at halftime
checks.evidence: p1 filmed game went through halftime on its own (commit 8e89838)

checks.title: Men still walking at the snap (illegal motion, teleport)
checks.evidence: p1: plays with a pop 61 -> 3, none at the snap

checks.title: Facemask tackle clips used as clean tackles, never flagged
checks.evidence: p5 telemetry: no Facemask/HorseCollar tackle clip played (only WR presnap fidgets); facemask now a sim foul on the tackler

checks.title: Punts, field goals and extra points are canned animations, not played
checks.evidence: State Kick / UpdateKick

checks.title: Penalties are dice rolls, not from what happens on the field
checks.evidence: p7 log: "PENALTY on OKC: Offensive Holding (#78 K.Blackwell)" - fouls from PlayResult risks, called on the man

checks.title: Game clock frozen through the presnap (runoff applied after)
checks.evidence: p10 c016: game clock 3:57 -> 3:27 with the play clock :37 -> :07 through the pre-snap (running clock); c013 after an incompletion: game clock held 4:56, play clock :37 -> :16

checks.title: Kicked balls (punt/FG/PAT) fly on a scripted arc
checks.evidence: p7 c049 f60: the PAT high over the bar on the solved drag flight; punts land on the sim spot

checks.title: Stale HUD: '1st & 10' on kickoffs, 'KICKOFF' on a PAT, a flag line through the next play
checks.evidence: p7 c049 f60: EXTRA POINT down box, score held at 6 with the kick in the air; KICKOFF on kickoffs

checks.title: Camera lags the ball on long runs (tackle at the frame edge)
checks.evidence: p7: carrier inside the safe frame in 99.8% of 6287 live frames

checks.title: Kick result text floats in the scene
checks.evidence: p7 c051 f15: no text over the field on the play after a PAT

checks.title: No first-down line or play-clock graphic
checks.evidence: p7 frames: yellow first-down line and the play clock beside the down box (:39 / :37)

checks.title: No stat overlays after big plays
checks.evidence: big plays (20+ yd or a TD) show the man's game line at the whistle (#N F. Last  N rec, N yds, N TD)
